newsitem.title: CANADA: Suncor Energy sets C$150 mln debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Suncor Energy sets C$150 mln debt issue.

text.p: Suncor Energy Inc said on Friday that it agreed to issue C$150 million of medium-term notes, completing the amount available under its C$400 million short-form shelf prospectus set in February.
Suncor said the notes, to mature on August 7, 2007, had a coupon of 6.10 percent and were priced at C$99.778 to yield 6.13 percent.
It said the issue was not related to Suncor's announcement on Thursday of a planned expansion at its oil sands plant.
A previous issue of C$250 million under the shelf prospectus was completed in March.
Suncor said the notes were rated A by Canadian Bond Rating Service and Dominion Bond Rating Service.
Net proceeds from the issue would be C$149.1 million, which would be added to general funds and applied principally to repay commercial paper borrowings, the company said.
Agents for the issue included RBC Dominion Securities Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, ScotiaMcleod Inc and Nesbitt Burns Inc. ((Jeffrey Jones, Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
